title: Free Community Microchipping Day
location: Layton Community House, 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP
description: Layton Community House and Longview Animal Centre (your local independent RSPCA branch) are working together to help local pet owners keep their cats and dogs safe. Saturday 17 October, 10am–3pm at Layton Community House, 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP. Microchipping is quick and simple, and gives your pet the best chance of being reunited with you if they ever go missing – it's also now a legal requirement. No appointment needed, just come along. Please bring cats in a secure carrier and keep dogs on a secure lead. Layton Community House on Facebook →

title: Pride in Place Layton: Community Party
description: The finale of Pride in Place Layton – a free community party for everyone, including families, with entertainment, activities and prizes. Sunday 11 October, 2:00pm at Layton Institute. Free to attend, but booking is required. Book your place →

title: Lightpool 2026: Welcoming Winter at the Field of Dreams
location: Field of Dreams, Bowness Ave, Blackpool, FY4 4TE
description: Artist Ivan Morison worked in the field to turn the harvested crop into a series of sculptures, coated in sand and lime – creatures that will look after the meadow over winter. This Lightpool, help welcome these field creatures to the land, with an evening of unexpected light from artists AndNow. Friday 23 October, 6:30pm-8pm at the Field of Dreams. Free. Part of "Autumn in the Field of Dreams", run by Leftcoast, supported by Arts Council England. Under 14s must be accompanied by an adult.
